verdict.rationale: Sai's own docs say the agent runs on a cloud Windows computer and that BYOD supports Mac mini, macOS and Windows devices. The open-source framework is also described as working 'across environments'. So the same agent targets at least two OSes, but per-target support appears only as a single-line mention. Missing for 10: detailed per-OS support documentation (capabilities, limitations, setup per target), any Linux or mobile target support (phone is only a command channel), independent or hands-on corroboration.
